facts.fact: Vic安慰Adam：他经历的是实实在在的折磨（literally tortured），他正在好转，只是需要时间。
facts.anchor: “But you were tortured, baby. Literally tortured, and you can’t see it because you’re in it, but you are better.

facts.fact: Dautre带着Emily几分钟后抵达Adam的公寓，参加为Cole灵魂举办的招灵会。
facts.anchor: Dautre arrived with Emily a few moments later.

facts.fact: Jodi也来了，Adam庆幸邀请了她，觉得她或许需要一个了结（closure）。
facts.anchor: Jodi came too, and Adam was glad he’d invited her. She might need the closure.

facts.fact: Vic以死神形态审问Cole的灵魂后转述：Cole对自己所做的一切感到自豪，声称拆毁一切是带来改变的唯一办法。
facts.anchor: “He was proud of what he’d done, said it was the only way to make a change, to tear it all down.

facts.fact: Cole供认他的灵魂瓶是从imps（小恶魔）手里买的。
facts.anchor: “He said he bought them from the imps.”

facts.fact: Cole把Cathedra音乐会当作目标，因为那是一群女巫，他估计能捕获a dozen（一打）灵魂。
facts.anchor: “It was a crowd of witches. He figured they’d be able to snare a dozen souls.

facts.fact: Cole称幕后主使没有留名，双方通过email联系，并且他说自己并非唯一一个。
facts.anchor: He claims they communicated by email, but he also said he’s not the only one.”

facts.fact: Cole深信他们正在做的事会成功，他们要促成之事将把royals（王室）拉下台。
facts.anchor: “He was pretty confident that what they were doing was going to work, that whatever they were bringing to pass, would bring the royals down.”
